state.seed_assertion: A DPIA is required in the case of a systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person.

sentences.1: A DPIA is required in the case of a systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person.
sentences.10: A legal or similarly significant effect is something that has a noticeable impact on an individual and can significantly affect their circumstances, behaviour or choices.
sentences.2: a systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person
sentences.3: Article 35(3) sets out three types of processing which always require a DPIA: Systematic and extensive profiling with significant effects: "(a) any systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person."
sentences.4: Systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects based on automated processing, including profiling, on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person, is one type of processing that always requires a DPIA.
sentences.5: A DPIA is required at least in the following cases: a systematic and extensive evaluation of the personal aspects of an individual based on automated processing, including profiling
sentences.6: A DPIA is required for a systematic and extensive evaluation of the personal aspects of an individual based on automated processing, including profiling.
sentences.7: A DPIA must be carried out for processing activities involving the combination, matching or comparison of personal data collected from processing activities having different purposes, provided that they produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person.
sentences.8: Processing activities involving the combination, matching or comparison of personal data collected from processing activities having different purposes (from the same or different data controllers)- provided that they produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affects the natural person
sentences.9: Automated-decision making with legal or similar significant effect - Explanation and examples: Processing that aims at taking decisions on individuals producing legal effects concerning the individual or which similarly significantly affects the individual
